definitions.explanation: A spiral movement of water or air.
Figuratively, being caught up in something.

examples.japanese: {渦|うず}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: I got caught in a whirlpool.

examples.japanese: {戦争|せんそう}の{渦|うず}の{中|なか}にいた。
examples.english: I was in the midst of war.

examples.japanese: {強|つよ}い{渦|うず}が{発生|はっせい}した。
{台風|たいふう}の{渦|うず}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: You can see the vortex of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}が{渦|うず}を{巻|ま}いている。
{鳴門|なると}の{渦潮|うずしお}を{見|み}た。
{渦|うず}{巻|ま}き{状|じょう}に{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: It's spinning in a spiral shape.

examples.japanese: {銀河|ぎんが}が{渦|うず}を{描|えが}いている。
{煙|けむり}が{渦|うず}を{巻|ま}いて{上|のぼ}った。
{紛争|ふんそう}の{渦|うず}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: I got caught up in the turmoil of conflict.

examples.japanese: {感情|かんじょう}の{渦|うず}の{中|なか}にいた。
examples.english: I was in the midst of emotional turmoil.

examples.japanese: {混乱|こんらん}の{渦|うず}に{陥|おちい}った。
examples.english: I fell into a whirlpool of confusion.

examples.japanese: {噂|うわさ}の{渦|うず}の{中心|ちゅうしん}にいる。
examples.english: I'm at the center of the rumor mill.

examples.japanese: {空気|くうき}が{渦|うず}を{巻|ま}いた。

notes:
{渦|うず} refers to a whirlpool, vortex, or spiral — both literally (water, air) and figuratively (turmoil, chaos). It is used frequently in figurative expressions describing being caught up in events.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {渦|うず}を{巻|ま}く: to swirl, to form a spiral
- {渦|うず}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get caught up in (literal or figurative)
- {渦|うず}の{中|なか}: in the midst of

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
Often paired with abstract nouns to express turmoil:
- {感情|かんじょう}の{渦|うず}: a whirl of emotions
- {混乱|こんらん}の{渦|うず}: a whirlpool of confusion
- {噂|うわさ}の{渦|うず}: a storm of rumors

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {渦巻|うずま}き: spiral (shape or pattern)
- {渦潮|うずしお}: whirlpool, tidal vortex (the {鳴門|なると}の{渦潮|うずしお} are especially famous)
